GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 6th 3 Lengths 800m lost spot 8th 6 Lengths home turn 10th Hooked Out Middle Of Track ran on final 100m # lost spot/good run
Jumped Ok Settled Down outside leader. 2nd turn. got to front in Straight . grabbed last stride # Every Chance

All but walked out of stall and showed little pace initially, circled field early stages eventually settling Two Wide Outside lead, held together much same to turn 1 length Two Wide , Dropped Out in straight. (Blinkers FIRST TIME) # slow/worked early
Jumped okay & Settled Down 1.5 Lengths 3 Wide , Restrained looking for cover at 850m, found none and worked back up to 1 length 3 Wide turning, Lost Ground in Straight # always Wide
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped on jumping.  Raced wide, without cover, in the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began fairly. Not pushed early & raced 5th Two Wide (3L from lead). Held Ground midrace & pushed to quicken 3 Wide @ 450m. Pushed along Five Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Six Wide @ 250m & weakened in last 150m. Vetted clear. # didn't finish off
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: At the entrance to the straight shifted out and bumped another runner. When questioned regarding the mares performance jockey stated his mount failed to sprint strongly on straightening and raced like a tired horse. Trainer advised the mare would be spelled. A post-race veterinary examination of the mare did not reveal any abnormality.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped ok Wide out & couldn't get in settled down fourth 2-3 Lengths (800m), dropped back Turn , no run on Straight # always Wide
Jumped Well from a low draw. Settled Down 2nd 1 length @ 700m. Two Wide Just shaded Straightening Up . Joined Lead to 200. Sound all way but No Match for $3.30 winner last bit # Sound on-speed

( winkers off ) Jumped Well from Inside . held rail 5th 4 Lengths @ 800m. Same Position Straightening Up Hooked Out Middle Of Track Best Going . Held Ground . Race Of Little Change (vetted - no abnormalities) # steady/ok
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned regarding the performance rider stated that the gelding travelled uncomfortably throughout the event, was under pressure from the 600m and was inclined to lay out in the straight. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow away. Niggled to recover & raced well back Two Wide (7L from lead) early . Back 1 length midrace & pushed to chase 3 Wide @ 600m & pressured Five Wide (7L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Six Wide @ 300m & no improvement in straight. winkers first time. # Never a chance.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Hampered & carried wider near 800m. Raced wide, without cover, from this point. When quest rdr stated mount bounded on jumping & consequently was obliged to settle at rear of field. Rdr stated field was spread out in middle stages &, with runners in advance not improving, he was obliged to shift wider passing 700m to commence working into event & make ground on leading division. Rdr stated mount did not handle tight turning circuit during this time & was inclined to hang out to h/turn. Rdr stated mount sprinted fairly in straight but could not make required ground on leaders. P/R vet no ab's.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Went Forward from Outside Settled Down = Lead Outside same to straightening up dueled to 100m, couldn't finish off - # =lead, gave all
Jumped awkwardly & Settled Down 5 Lengths 3 Wide , Drifted Back to 7 Lengths Four Wide turning, Held Ground and passed tiring runners in Straight # very distant 3rd
